text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Patient Infosystems Inc with an attractive rating and a price target of $13 a share.

-- Vector said the company's services are aimed at reducing the costs associated with chronic medical conditions, which total an estimated $425 billion annually. Patient Infosystems has 15 contracts in place for seven disease states so far and is well on its way to becoming a major player in the intersection between disease management and healthcare information technology, Vector said.
-- Patient Infosystems programs monitor patient progress between treatment and recovery away from the point of care.
-- Its shares were down 1/4 Wednesday at 8-3/4.
